patch.value: defineExtensionBlueprint: typed identity helper for partial blueprint fragments

Add defineExtensionBlueprint(blueprint): TBlueprint to src/sdk/compose.ts — a zero-cost typed identity helper for a (partial) ExtensionBlueprint authored as its own module, the typed entry point of the modular declarative-authoring loop and natural companion to mergeExtensionBlueprints. Completes the define* symmetry: defineExtension (whole module), defineExtensionManifest (manifest), defineExtensionBlueprint (blueprint fragment). In TypeScript it preserves the narrow literal type while checking the fragment against the ExtensionBlueprint interface and gives contextual handler-parameter inference (the Vite defineConfig pattern), so each concern can be authored, exported, and unit-tested in its own .ts file then combined via mergeExtensionBlueprints. Re-exported from the SDK barrel; 100% line + docstring coverage; documented in docs/SDK.md Modular blueprints section.
Added defineExtensionBlueprint typed identity helper completing the define* symmetry (module/manifest/blueprint).
